actual: The r5 full-evaluation engine can return IEEE NaN for scientifically unavailable metrics such as zero-variance or insufficient-observation statistics. The research JSON contract correctly forbids non-finite values, but runner output writes encode() directly, leaving a zero-byte metrics.json and marking an otherwise computed candidate failed. Preserve strict non-finite input rejection; normalize computed unavailable metrics to JSON null with explicit existing status/reason semantics, never zero or silent row removal. Reproduced on task 1a14a0bc-0d9a-4290-ab15-f000e07f12d1 attempt f83c1bcd-c859-4d4d-887c-8b8f621a0e20.
